description: This file defines an interface `IGrainContext` and related interfaces and extension methods used within the Orleans framework. It encapsulates the context of a grain from the runtime perspective, including identity, lifecycle, activation management, and scheduling. It also contains auxiliary interfaces for scheduling, extension management, and activation collection.

classes.name: IGrainContext
classes.description: Represents a grain within the runtime, providing access to its identity, lifecycle, and operational methods.

classes.name: ICollectibleGrainContext
classes.description: An internal interface extending IGrainContext, adding properties for activation collection management.

classes.name: IWorkItemScheduler
classes.description: Interface for scheduling work items and tasks on a grain.

classes.name: IGrainContextAccessor
classes.description: Provides access to the current execution context of a grain.

classes.name: IGrainExtensionBinder
classes.description: Manages grain extensions, allowing retrieval and registration of extension interfaces.

classes.name: GrainContextExtensions
classes.description: Contains extension methods for IGrainContext, such as asynchronous deactivation.

methods.name: SetComponent
methods.description: Sets a component of a specified type for the grain context.

methods.name: ReceiveMessage
methods.description: Submits an incoming message to the grain instance.

methods.name: Activate
methods.description: Activates the grain instance with optional request context and cancellation.

methods.name: Deactivate
methods.description: Deactivates the grain instance with a specified reason and optional cancellation.

methods.name: Rehydrate
methods.description: Restores the grain state from a rehydration context.

methods.name: Migrate
methods.description: Initiates migration of the grain activation to another location.

methods.name: DelayDeactivation
methods.description: Delays the deactivation or collection of the grain activation.
